title: ReLEAP: Upcycling Vision Datasets through Cross-Task Unification and Semi-Supervised Annotation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32289v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Developing robust vision models requires large amounts of annotated data, especially for tasks involving fine-grained class distinctions under variable environmental conditions. Even in domains with numerous existing datasets, differences in annotation formats, label definitions and targeted learning tasks hinder data reuse and integration. To address this challenge, we introduce ReLEAP, a scalable Python framework for unifying heterogeneous image datasets through data-source abstraction, systematic reuse of annotations across learning tasks, and mapping of labels to a shared hierarchical taxonomy. We demonstrate its applicability in precision agriculture by integrating fifteen diverse datasets covering a broad range of plant species and annotation types. translated_title: ReLEAP：通过跨任务统一与半监督标注提升视觉数据集的价值
translated_abstract: 开发稳健的视觉模型需要大量标注数据，尤其是在可变环境条件下涉及细粒度类别区分的任务。即使在一些拥有众多现有数据集的领域，标注格式、标签定义和目标学习任务的差异也阻碍了数据的重用与整合。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了ReLEAP，这是一个可扩展的Python框架，通过数据源抽象、跨学习任务的系统性标注重用，以及将标签映射到共享的层级分类体系，来统一异构图像数据集。我们通过整合十五个涵盖广泛植物物种和标注类型的多样化数据集，展示了该框架在精准农业中的适用性。除了数据统一之外，ReLEAP还能实现对现有数据的系统性回收利用，并为基于学习的标注升级提供坚实基础。利用这一基础，我们……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ReLEAP提出了一个可扩展的Python框架，通过数据源抽象、跨任务标注重用和统一层级分类体系来整合异构视觉数据集，并结合半监督标注实现对现有数据的系统性回收与标注升级，在精准农业领域整合十五个数据集验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: ReLEAP is a scalable Python framework that unifies heterogeneous vision datasets through data-source abstraction, cross-task annotation reuse, and shared hierarchical taxonomy mapping, enabling semi-supervised annotation upcycling, as demonstrated by integrating fifteen diverse precision agriculture datasets.
